records.name: Subject: Torment
records.description: Hwei envisions a series of torments, allowing him to paint controlling visages. This ability replaces Hwei's abilities with crowd control abilities: Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss, and Crushing Maw.

description.value: Hwei envisions a series of torments, allowing him to paint controlling visages. This ability replaces Hwei's abilities with crowd control abilities: Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss, and Crushing Maw.

tooltip.value: Hwei paints visions of torment that control enemies. Grim Visage Hwei launches a terrifying face that causes the first enemy hit to Flee for {{ tooltip_eqfleeduration }} second(s) and take {{ tooltip_eqdamage }} magic damage . Gaze of the Abyss Hwei forms an eye that lingers and provides vision locking onto the first enemy champion that enters and launching a homing missile that Roots the first enemy hit for {{ tooltip_ewrootduration }} seconds dealing {{ tooltip_ewdamage }} magic damage . Crushing Maw Hwei paints a set of jaws at a target location that Drags enemies to the center dealing {{ tooltip_eedamage }} magic damage and Slowing enemies caught by {{ tooltip_eeslowamount }}% decaying over 1.25 seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

records.name: Subject: Disaster
records.description: Hwei envisions a series of disasters, allowing him to paint a devastating blow. This ability replaces Hwei's abilities with damaging abilities: Devastating Fire, Severing Bolt, and Molten Fissure.

description.value: Hwei envisions a series of disasters, allowing him to paint a devastating blow. This ability replaces Hwei's abilities with damaging abilities: Devastating Fire, Severing Bolt, and Molten Fissure.

tooltip.value: Hwei paints visions of disaster that deal large damage to enemies. Devastating Fire Hwei launches a blazing fast fireball that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing {{ tooltip_qqdamage }} plus {{ tooltip_qqbonusdamage }}% max health magic damage . Severing Bolt Hwei strikes over far distances with a delayed lightning bolt, dealing {{ tooltip_qwdamage }} magic damage . Hitting an Isolated or Immobilized target increases the damage up to {{ tooltip_qwbonusdamage }} magic damage , based on the target's missing health. Molten Fissure Hwei unleashes a path of eruptions, dealing {{ tooltip_qedamage }} magic damage in an area and leaving behind pools of lava that Slow enemies by {{ spell.hweiqe:slowpercent }}% and deal {{ tooltip_qedamagepersecond }} magic damage per second for {{ spell.hweiqe:duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

records.name: Spiraling Despair
records.description: Hwei paints a vision of pure despair. The first enemy champion struck becomes the center of an expanding painting that slows and damages nearby enemies. The vision explodes after reaching its maximum size or when the champion dies.

description.value: Hwei paints a vision of pure despair. The first enemy champion struck becomes the center of an expanding painting that slows and damages nearby enemies. The vision explodes after reaching its maximum size or when the champion dies.

tooltip.value: Hwei launches a vision of pure despair that sticks to an enemy champion for {{ duration }} seconds. The vision expands over time applying a Slow to enemies for {{ slowpercentperstack }}% stacking every 0.25 seconds, and dealing {{ damageovertime }} magic damage per second . Upon completion, the vision shatters, dealing {{ damage }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

records.name: Subject: Serenity
records.description: Hwei envisions a series of serenities, allowing him to paint invigorating settings. This ability replaces Hwei's abilities with utility abilities: Fleeting Current, Pool of Reflection, and Stirring Lights.

description.value: Hwei envisions a series of serenities, allowing him to paint invigorating settings. This ability replaces Hwei's abilities with utility abilities: Fleeting Current, Pool of Reflection, and Stirring Lights.

tooltip.value: Hwei paints visions of serenity that provide utility for himself and allied champions. Fleeting Current Hwei launches a current of swift waters in a line that grants allies {{ tooltip_wqmovespeed }} Move Speed . Pool of Reflection Hwei forms a protective pool that grants {{ tooltip_wwshieldamount }} Shields over time to allied champions inside reduced by {{ spell.hweiww:tooltipallymod*100 }}% for allies. Stirring Lights Hwei creates three swirling lights that empower his next three Abilities or Attacks to deal an additional {{ tooltip_weonhitdamage }} magic damage and restore {{ tooltip_weonhitmanarestore }} Mana each.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

records.name: Signature of the Visionary
records.description: Hwei primes enemy champions he damages with his abilities for his signature finishing touch. Hitting an enemy with a second damaging spell completes his signature, leaving it beneath them. The signature detonates after a short delay, dealing magic damage to all enemies in range.

records.name: Hwei
records.description: Hwei is a brooding painter who creates brilliant art in order to confront Ionia's criminals and comfort their victims. Beneath his melancholy roils a torn, emotional mind—haunted by both the vibrant visions of his imagination and the gruesome memories...

lore.value: Hwei is a brooding painter who creates brilliant art in order to confront Ionia's criminals and comfort their victims. Beneath his melancholy roils a torn, emotional mind—haunted by both the vibrant visions of his imagination and the gruesome memories of his temple's massacre. Hwei seeks to understand this light and dark, which drives him inevitably toward the artist who unraveled him. With paintbrush and palette, Hwei shapes endless possibilities as he draws ever closer to earning closure or embracing despair.
